artworks.title: Wendingen
artworks.medium: color lithograph; cover for the illustrated magazine "Wendingen" [plus the 36-page text]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Frank R. and Jeannette H. Eyerly

artworks.title: A Peasant Woman Goes for Water
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Frank R. and Jeannette H. Eyerly
artworks.description: The image depicts a complex arrangement of geometric shapes and angular lines. Triangles, rectangles, and shaded areas interlock to create an abstract composition with a patchwork-like appearance. There are forms that resemble figures or structures found in urban landscapes. The drawing consists of sharp edges and varying shades of gray. The interplay of shapes suggests movement and interaction, prompting viewers to examine how these forms align into recognizable patterns.

artworks.title: Standing Philosopher and Two Other Figures
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 13.3 x 17.2 cm (5 1/4 x 6 3/4 in.)
sheet (trimmed close to plate mark): 13.6 x 17.5 cm (5 3/8 x 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Frank R. and Jeannette H. Eyerly
artworks.description: The image shows two figures from the thighs up. The figure on the left is bent over, with their upper body leaning forward and their face directed downward. The individual on the left has uncovered hair and is wearing a garment with wide sleeves. The person on the right is standing upright, has a beard, is wearing headwear and a cloak draped over their shoulders. Both figures wear loose, flowing robes. The background includes trees, foliage, and a large vase or urn on the ground, indicating an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with a Herd of Goats and a Herm
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper tinted pale blue
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a cluster of trees at the horizon, a large tree blending into the figure of a man in the foreground, and a flock of sheep grazing in the distance. The style features detailed linework and textures resembling etching or engraving, using a monochromatic palette of black and white for depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Une répétition à L'Oeuvre, Program for L'Oasis
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper bound in theater program with blue paper cover
artworks.dimensions:
page size: 30.2 x 20.6 cm (11 7/8 x 8 1/8 in.)
overall size (program opened): 30.2 x 42.1 cm (11 7/8 x 16 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theater stage during a rehearsal. The image shows an interior view of a theater, with a stage framed by a large proscenium arch. The stage is bustling with activity, as silhouettes of figures are clustered towards the center. The background features tall curtains, and stair steps lead up to the elevated stage platform. The drawing employs a sketchy, dynamic style with strong contrasts of light and shadow, giving the scene a sense of depth and motion. The intricate cross-hatching technique is used to convey texture and form, particularly in the drapery and the architectural elements of the stage.

artworks.title: La Vie muette
artworks.medium: lithograph in green-black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring text and abstract figures in a forest setting. The composition is rustic and sepia-toned. The drawing contains text that reads "LA VIE MUETTE." On the left, there are abstract, intertwined forms resembling figures in motion, drawn with flowing lines. On the right, there is a figure standing among trees, facing away and wearing a long coat. The background shows an abstract forest scene with tree trunks. The drawing style is influenced by late 19th-century aesthetics with impressionistic outlines and textures.

artworks.title: Les Soutiens de la société
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on light brown wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a room with text and figures within it. The composition is divided into two parts: the left side filled with textual information about a theatrical performance and the right side illustrating a dimly lit room with several figures. The figures are sketched in an expressive, loose style, creating a slightly mysterious atmosphere. The central figure appears seated, surrounded by draped curtains, hints of a window, and indistinct forms suggesting other furniture or objects in the room. The text provides details of a publication and a performance by Henrik Ibsen. The dark, scratchy lines and shading of the drawing contribute to an overall dramatic and enigmatic mood.

artworks.title: Les Soutiens de la société
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene. The image depicts a room with a window, framed with patterned glass and partially concealed by draped curtains. Within the room, there are several indistinct figures. The overall atmosphere is intimate and somewhat somber, with heavy use of shadow and light creating depth and texture. The figures are gathered around a central point.

artworks.title: Rosmersholm
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on light brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a sketch-like drawing of a scene with a seated, bald figure and a standing figure to the left. Handwritten text details names and roles related to "Rosmersholm" by Henrik Ibsen. The background shows floral-like shapes and a grid pattern suggesting windows. The composition has a loose, impressionistic feel.

artworks.title: Solness le constructeur
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a series of vertical lines and blurred shapes that create depth and movement. The composition gives the impression of tall trees in a forest. There is text overlay with titles and names, integrating with the misty background. The overall appearance is of an old, weathered poster resembling vintage playbills.

artworks.title: Un Ennemi du peuple
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays swirling and curving shapes and lines that contribute to its abstract quality. The text is arranged in a non-linear fashion, with curving lines that suggest a dynamic flow. Interspersed among the text are illustrated forms that hint at human figures, seen on the left and towards the bottom. The visual arrangement creates an impression of a theatrical poster with an artistic style that abstracts the concept of a playbill into a bold composition.

artworks.title: Une Nuit d'Avril à Céos; L'Image
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on light brown wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an abstract black-and-cream composition with text and figures. The image shows a textured depiction primarily in sepia tones, featuring figures on either side of a column of handwritten text. On the left, the figure is positioned near a window, with light falling upon them, while the right side portrays more defined, draped forms. The artwork includes various text elements, suggesting a poster or announcement. The arrangement and use of light and dark contrast create a dream-like atmosphere. This is in the style of Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec.

artworks.title: Une répétition à L'Oeuvre, Program for L'Oasis
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stage with several figures seemingly in the midst of a performance or rehearsal. The image depicts a view of a theatre stage from an off-stage perspective, capturing the shadows and forms of individuals in mid-motion. The scene is dominated by strong contrasts and heavy use of lines and shading, emphasizing the dramatic interplay of light and dark. The foreground features the faint outline of stairs leading up to the stage, and the background consists of large stage curtains and lighting equipment. The entirety of the image is rendered in monochrome, using varying intensities of black and gray shades to create depth and texture. The style conveys a sense of the dynamic and ephemeral nature of theatrical productions.

artworks.title: Chevalerie rustique; L'Amante du Christ; Marié; Les Bouchers
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatre programme for the Théâtre Libre. The programme features an illustration on the left side and text listing the performances and cast on the right. The illustration displays a dynamic scene of a fictional character in a white costume interacting with a figure in a green outfit. The artwork is accompanied by a handwritten verse and signature by Rodolphe Darzens. The right side of the programme lists various plays like "CHEVALERIE RUSTIQUE," "L'AMANTE DU CHRIST," "MARIE," and "LES BOUCHERS," along with actors' names and roles. It provides details about the premiere night on Friday, October 19, 1888, at the Théâtre des Menus-Plaisirs in Paris.

artworks.title: Brand
artworks.medium: lithograph in green on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Martin and Liane W. Atlas
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various sections of text and illustrations in blue on a beige background. The left side includes the text "L'OEUVRE" at the top, alongside details about an administration and a spectacle. At the bottom, there is a profile illustration of a bearded figure with text about a literary and artistic review. The right side displays an illustration of a figure with water dripping off their face, surrounded by text that includes a list of names and descriptive text related to the author Ibsen. The artwork uses soft shading and fluid lines.

artworks.title: Les Honnêtes femmes; Conférence, Poésies inédites d'Henry Becque; La Parisienne
artworks.medium: halftone on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (program closed): 32.7 x 25 cm (12 7/8 x 9 13/16 in.)
sheet (program opened): 32.7 x 50.1 cm (12 7/8 x 19 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: Printed with smoky gray and black tones on cream-white paper, a man wearing a dark suit raises a cane as if to strike as a skeleton crouches beside him in this vertical halftone print. To the left, the man’s short hair blows back as he raises his right arm, to our left, across his body. His brow is deeply furrowed, his eyes scrunched, and his mouth open. His cane reaches behind his head. A top hat along his left side, to our right, could belong to him or another person in the indistinct background. To the right, the skeleton sits with knees drawn up and one hand under its chin. A garland of roses drapes around its neck and down between its legs. The body is wrapped in a light cloth. Three large black birds, perhaps oversized crows, swoop to our left from the top right corner, their wings wide and beaks reaching forward. The setting is drawn in with shading and indistinct forms, suggesting deep shadows and perhaps swirling sky. The scene is framed with a black line and the word “Programme” appears across the bottom. A monogram of a conjoined “AB” is in the lower right corner of the image, and a tiny, printed inscription in the lower left reads, “M.X. Sc.”

artworks.title: Le Repas du lion
artworks.medium: collotype in red on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man sitting with his arms resting on his knees and his head resting on his hand. His head is slightly tilted, and he appears to be looking to the side. The man's facial features are abstract and loosely detailed, with a suggestion of a contemplative expression. His hair is sketched vaguely, appearing as a rough outline. The drawing shows the man with a muscular build, and the lines give an impression of a draped garment or loose clothing around him. No specific jewelry is depicted, and he does not hold any objects. The background behind the figure is a blank space. The sketch is on a printed page that also contains text referencing a performance at Théâtre Antoine for the 1897-1898 season.

artworks.title: A View of the Arno, Florence
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a row of buildings rising vertically, with little sky visible, suggesting a low-angle viewpoint, almost from water level. The buildings meet a body of water, where the horizon aligns with their bases. In the distance, the buildings form a continuous layer of arches, balconies, and windows, rendered with meticulous pencil lines. The artist's technique involves precise, linear brushstrokes for a detailed scene. Light and shadows are indicated through subtle shading, creating a monochromatic color palette of various shades of gray and white. In the lower part, a gondola with an occupant is depicted, reflected in the water, adding depth to the cityscape.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child with an Escaped Goldfinch
artworks.medium: red chalk on thin laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The drawing illustrates the upper body of two figures. The central figure is seated, looking to the left towards a bird in flight. The person has soft facial features with wavy hair arranged atop their head. They are dressed in draped clothing. With them is a child standing upright, partially supported by the seated figure's arm. The child has curly hair and looks directly towards the viewer. The drawing appears to use a single color medium, creating a monochromatic effect. The background is minimal, focusing on textures created by the medium, with the highlight of the bird adding an element of motion.

artworks.title: Rocaille Fountain with Venus, Amorini, and Swans
artworks.medium: red chalk on 2 joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a figure seated in a shell with cherubs below. The drawing shows a central figure seated on a large shell-like structure. The scene is framed within an arch-like structure. Below the main figure, several cherubic figures with wings are positioned. The entire piece features delicate and flowing lines, likely executed in red chalk. Light shading and cross-hatching brings depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Saint Mark with Two Bishops and Putti
artworks.artist: Attributed to Jacopo Palma il Giovane
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white, over black chalk on light brown (formerly blue) laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with multiple figures. A seated person is in the upper part of the image, dressed in flowing robes, with distinct facial features including pronounced eyebrows and a beard. They are seated on a raised platform, with one hand on a book. Beside them is a sculpted lion. Two individuals below the seated person are likely religious figures, wearing long robes and tall hats. They stand facing each other, each holding a bishop's crosier. The background above the seated person features two cherubs holding objects. The scene is set against a plain backdrop with sketched architectural details. The composition is in sepia tones with white highlights.

artworks.title: Fountain in a Summerhouse
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a garden with a large arch structure covered in greenery and trellis work. In the center of the garden is a sculptural fountain with a female figure pouring water. A male figure stands nearby, and a distant statue is partially visible. The scene is intricately detailed with fine lines, and the color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and sepia. The garden's exit is visible in the distance, lined with trees and structures.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with a Pollarded Tree
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper tinted pale blue
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective of a dense forest scene. The composition includes trees, foliage, fine lines, cross-hatching for texture, and a monochromatic color palette. A large tree trunk is in the center, with branches extending upwards. A small waterfall is visible to the right. In the distance, a figure is partially obscured by foliage. The background features more forest vegetation.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with a Nymph and a Satyr
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper tinted pale blue
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a forest scene with towering trees dominating the upper half. The horizon is not clearly visible due to dense foliage, but a line of trees and rocky outcrops in the distance provide a boundary. The fine lines and cross-hatching technique create detailed textures in the tree bark and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of black and white emphasizing light and shadow. A large tree with a partially hollow trunk and figures scattered throughout the scene give a sense of scale and activity within the forest setting.
